title: EX Champion Daruk's Song
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|This article is about the Main Quest in {{BotW}}. For other uses, see [[Champion Daruk's Song]].}} {{Infobox Quest |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= [[File:BotW EX Champion Daruk's Song.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |type= Main |game= BotW |giver= [[Monk|???]] |location= '''{{Color BotW|Main Quest|[[Eldin Mountains]]}}'''{{Note|Although the [[Adventure Log]] description denotes the location as the Eldin Mountains, the Quest is actually received in the [[Eldin Canyon]].}} |prereq= Complete [[Great Plateau]] trials |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Daruk's Protection +}} |previous= |next= }} "'''EX Champion Daruk's Song'''" is a [[Main Quest]] in {{BotW}}. It is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] pack. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|EX Champion Daruk's Song||Series, BotW}} | {{BotW}} }} ==Overview== After finishing the trials of the [[Great Plateau]] during "[[EX The Champions' Ballad]]", the [[One-Hit Obliterator]] will split into four glowing orbs and scatter to different areas of [[Hyrule Kingdom]]. When they land, they reveal four ancient structures called [[Monument]]s. One of the Monuments appears in the [[Eldin Canyon]] on a ledge overlooking the [[Golow River]]. As [[Link]] approaches the Monument, a voice belonging to an unspecified [[Monk]] speaks to him and instructs him to complete the trials at the locations shown to him.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|I applaud your courage in coming here. The locations that will be revealed to you are of trials that will enhance the power sleeping within. Do not let your guard down...}}|Monk|BotW}} Three maps then appear on the Monument's pillars, each revealing the location of a trial that Link must undergo within the [[Eldin (Region)|Eldin]] [[Region]]. [[Kass]], who is standing nearby, will make a remark on either the flashing light or the Monument itself, depending on how many Monuments Link has already visited.{{Cite|What was that...flash of light? Perhaps it was my imagination playing tricks on me.|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|Did that {{Color BotW|Blue|stone monument}} just start glowing? I suppose that proves I didn't imagine it the first time.|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|This {{Color BotW|Blue|stone monument}} has survived for 10,000 years. What secrets does it hold...|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|That light... Is it a reaction to someone nearby? Is it me...or is it...|Kass|BotW}} Noticing Link nearby, Kass is concerned about his ability to withstand the heat.{{Cite|What's this? A traveler in the land of flames? Are you truly able to withstand the heat? I know it's not my business, but I'm rather concerned.|Kass|BotW}} He asks Link if he also drank many [[Fireproof Elixir]]s.{{Cite|It must be...that you applied an ample amount of {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof elixir}}, just as I did. Is that so?|Kass|BotW}} If Link confirms this, Kass will remark that he is in a similar situation and would fry in a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite|[It is!] Yes, I knew it! I'm in the same boat, friend. If I don't use {{Color BotW|Blue|fireproof elixir}}, I go from a bard to a baked bird!|Kass|BotW}} However, if Link refutes this, Kass comments that he must have natural immunity to heat.{{Cite|[Nope.] How about that! You must have a natural ability to withstand intense heat, just like the {{Color BotW|Blue|Gorons}}!|Kass|BotW}} Dismissing himself, Kass points out the nearby Monument to Link, explaining it was mentioned in his teacher's [[Unfinished Song]].{{Cite|Well, never mind my musings. Look! I'm sure you already know, but it's one of the {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}} mentioned in my teacher's {{Color BotW|Blue|unfinished song}}.|Kass|BotW}}{{Note|If this is the first Monument that Link has visited, Kass will explain that it was mentioned in an Unfinished Song written by his teacher.{{Cite|This {{Color BotW|Blue|monument}}... I must admit it has taken me by surprise! My teacher's {{Color BotW|Blue|unfinished song}} mentions such {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}}, and now one has appeared before my eyes...|Kass|BotW}} At Link's confusion, Kass explains that it is missing its key verses.{{Cite|[Unfinished song?] Yes. The song is mostly complete. However... My teacher left this world without finishing the {{Color BotW|Blue|key verses}}.|Kass|BotW}} He is now on a journey to finish the song.{{Cite|I wish the weave the missing pieces together and finish the song.|Kass|BotW}}}} He wonders if his teacher worked on this Song at this spot.{{Cite|*sigh* I wonder if my teacher ever contemplated this very song at this very spot...|Kass|BotW}} He informs Link that there is a verse in the song that mentions the trials that [[Daruk]] overcame, which he will sing for him.{{Cite|The song my teacher left behind... There's {{Color BotW|Blue|a verse}} about the trials that {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Daruk}} overcame. Allow me to sing it for you...|Kass|BotW}} The verse provides Link with instructions for completing all three of Daruk's trials.{{Cite|♪Crawling flame on a mighty peak.
{{Color BotW|Blue|Rudania}}'s Champion, never weak.♪
♪The hero's power shall grow.
Seek trials {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}} show.♪
♪One, {{Color BotW|Red|stop a titan of molten stone}}.
Two, {{Color BotW|Red|follow rings of light alone}}.♪
♪Three, {{Color BotW|Red|survive lava's fiery fate}}.
Champion, trials await!♪|Kass|BotW}} After playing for Link, Kass asks Link if he was moved.{{Cite|...So? Did it move you?|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|...So? Did the {{Color BotW|Blue|verse}} move you? It was written in honor of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion}} challenging the trial.|Kass|BotW}} His journey has allowed him understand the [[Champions]], which he hopes will help him with finishing the key verses of the Unfinished Song.{{Cite|By understanding the true natures of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Champions}}, I'm closer than ever to completing those {{Color BotW|Blue|key verses}}. I can imagine it vividly...the Champion's vigilance from 100 years ago.|Kass|BotW}} He recalls that his teacher advised him to travel and meet people in order to write good songs, which has inspired his current way of living.{{Cite|My teacher always advised that, to write good songs, one must travel the world and meet lots of people. That is why I spend my days afoot, talking to anyone who will listen.|Kass|BotW}} Recently, Kass was able to meet with [[Yunobo]] and [[Bludo]], who told him much about Daruk.{{Cite|I was lucky enough to meet with {{Color BotW|Blue|Yunobo}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|Bludo}} in {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron City}}, both of whom knew much about the Goron Champion. They regaled me with some rather interesting stories!|Kass|BotW}} With their stories, Kass believes he will be able to finish the key verses.{{Cite|I'm certain the stories they shared will help me greatly in my efforts to accurately write the song's {{Color BotW|Blue|key verses}}.|Kass|BotW}} Afterwards, the [[Main Quest]] will begin. Link may complete the three trials in any order. The first trial involves defeating the [[Igneo Talus Titan]] on the shore of [[Lake Darman]], which reveals the [[Kamia Omuna Shrine]]. The second trial has Link follow the [[Glowing Ring]]s from the top of [[Death Mountain]], and in doing so, unearths the [[Sharo Lun Shrine]]. Finally, the third trial tasks Link with safely falling into the Glowing Ring over [[Darb Pond]]'s lava, thereby revealing [[Rinu Honika Shrine]]. Each of these [[Ancient Shrine]]s rewards Link with one of [[Rudania's Emblem]]s upon their completion.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Your resourcefulness in overcoming this trial speaks to the promise of a hero. In the name of the Goddess Hylia, I bestow upon you this gift... Rudania's Emblem.}}|Monk|BotW}} The Monk of the Shrine will then inform Link that collecting all three Emblems will unlock a new challenge.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Collect three emblems to open the path to a new challenge.}}|Monk|BotW}} They will tell Link how many more trials he has to complete before fading away.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Two remain...}}|Monk|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|One remains...}}|Monk|BotW}} After completing all three Shrines, the Monk of the third will instruct him to go to [[Divine Beast Vah Rudania]].{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Now that you have collected three emblems, you must go to Divine Beast Vah Rudania.}}|Monk|BotW}} As Link approaches the [[Divine Beast]], he is spoken to again by an unspecified Monk, who offers him a trial in his memories in exchange for Rudania's three Emblems.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|To the one who approaches this Divine Beast... In the name of the Goddess Hylia, I offer this trial. In exchange for Rudania's Emblems... you will be granted the chance to tread through the realm of memories.}}|Monk|BotW}} The Monk says the trial will be unforgiving without determination and reminds Link not to dismiss it as simple memories.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Those who lack determination will find this trial unforgiving. Do not take this place lightly nor dismiss it as merely a world within your mind. The truth is much deeper than you know.}}|Monk|BotW}} Link is then transported to the [[Illusory Realm]], a realm created by his memories, where he once again battles [[Fireblight Ganon]] on top of Divine Beast Vah Rudania.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|This illusory realm was created from the depths of your memories... The enemy you shall face is a product of the fear that dwells within. This battle is a trial of the soul. You must emerge victorious using only the tools provided.}}|Monk|BotW}} This Fireblight Ganon is a phantom born from Link's memories and fears.{{Cite|You defeated the phantom of Fireblight Ganon, which was born from your own memories and fears.|Adventure Log|BotW}} Link's [[Armor]], equipment, and [[Item]]s will be changed to the following: * [[Fireproof Armor]] (upgraded twice) * [[Boulder Breaker]] * [[Knight's Bow]] * Five [[Ice Arrow]]s * [[Seared Steak]] * [[Toasty Ironshroom]] * [[Baked Apple]] After defeating Fireblight Ganon for the second time, Link is transported back outside of Divine Beast Vah Rudania. He will find Kass nearby, who notices that he appears to still be lost in thought.{{Cite|Are you still adrift in thought? You seem lost to the whims of your mind. Oh... Pardon me. I suppose it's none of my business.|Kass|BotW}} He informs Link that learning about Daruk's tales has inspired him to write his own song in his honor.{{Cite|Ah! Wandering around here and listening to anecdotes about {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Daruk}} has truly invigorated me. In fact, it has inspired me to honor him in my own way, separate from my teacher's {{Color BotW|Blue|unfinished song}}. That is why I felt inclined to roost here, near the {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast Vah Rudania}}, which {{Color BotW|Blue|Daruk}} himself mastered. I've written a song...to try and capture the essence of {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Daruk}}...|Kass|BotW}} He will sing the song to Link,{{Cite|♪Recall {{Color BotW|Blue|Rudania}}'s Champion of flame,
before his fated moment finally came.♪
♪This is the tale of Great {{Color BotW|Blue|Daruk}}'s task,
and the princess who came to ask.♪|Kass|BotW}} which allows Link to visualize the "[[Champion Daruk's Song (Memory)|Champion Daruk's Song]]" [[Recovered Memory]] from 100 years ago,{{Cite|Kass's composition, entitled {{Color BotW|Red|Champion Daruk's Song}}, was so true and moving that it allowed you to visualize a memory from 100 years ago.|Adventure Log|BotW}} After the song, Kass notes that even Champions are capable of fear.{{Cite|Hmm... I suppose even Champions are not immune to fear.|Kass|BotW}} He asks Link what he thought of [[Champion Daruk's Song (Song)|Champion Daruk's Song]],{{Cite|So? What do you think of {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Daruk's Song}}?|Kass|BotW}} and he explains that writing it helped him feel closer to his teacher.{{Cite|By writing a song that celebrates the softer side of Champion Daruk, I feel closer than ever to my dear teacher.|Kass|BotW}} Content with his composition, Kass then remarks how [[Hyrule Castle]] would make a suitable setting for his teacher's song.{{Cite|The missing {{Color BotW|Blue|verses}} of an ancient song... I think the perfect setting would be {{Color BotW|Blue|Hyrule Castle}} in the distant past.|Kass|BotW}} [[File:BotW EX Champion Daruk's Song Vah Rudania.png|thumb|right|320px|alt= Screenshot of Link during the Quest.|Link outside Divine Beast Vah Rudania]] Link then hears the voice of Daruk, who congratulates him and says he can now use [[Daruk's Protection]] more often.{{Cite|I knew ya could do it, little guy! Now you can use Daruk's Protection more than ever.|Daruk|BotW}} If Link ever sees [[Calamity Ganon]], Daruk asks that he tell him good riddance for him.{{Cite|If ya see that Ganon jerk, give him a message for me... Good riddance, bacon-breath!|Daruk|BotW}} Link receives [[Daruk's Protection +]], which reduces the ability's recharge time to six minutes. After receiving the upgrade, the Main Quest is completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | The scattered One-Hit Obliterator led you to a location where a stone monument with a map of trials appeared. One, {{Color BotW|Red|stop a titan of molten lava}}.
Two, {{Color BotW|Red|follow rings of light alone}}.
Three, {{Color BotW|Red|survive lava's fiery fate}}.
Champion, trials await!

You still have {{Color BotW|Red|one}} trial to complete. |- | 4 | You completed the three trials inscribed on the stone monument in the Eldin region.

After you collected three of Rudania's Emblems, the monk told you to head to the Divine Beast. What awaits you there?

Go to the Divine Beast Vah Rudania to find out. |- | Complete | You defeated the phantom of Fireblight Ganon, which was born from your own memories and fears.

Kass's composition, entitled {{Color BotW|Red|Champion Daruk's Song}}, was so true and moving that it allowed you to visualize a memory from 100 years ago.

By conquering the trial, your sacred power has increased and Daruk's Protection has become more efficient than ever. }} ==Trivia== * "EX Champion Daruk's Song" is referenced by the "[[To Stand atop the Lava]]" [[Quest]], in which [[Daruk]] decides to attempt to stand on [[Lava]] without being harmed.{{Cite|Daruk's got his mind set on a test of courage that's never been tried before: standing atop bubbling lava! Help him prepare to achieve this seemingly impossible feat.|Gallery (Interface)|AoC}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Eldin Canyon * Eldin Mountains * EX Champion Mipha's Song * EX Champion Revali's Song * EX Champion Urbosa's Song * EX The Champions' Ballad * Monument }} {{Notes}} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|EX Champion Daruk's Song}}
